book.name: MAKI
book.title: Jisesi Kalaestida gala lalo Makimamo luhuwa jibo

content: Monoka noku udobetokaka we Jonida monokala.
Jisesi Kalaestiya Omaimidana ipaladamuya gala laloya sa-loko soto pibo maya ne.
Yamidana gawaya Omaimidana epaloti ga wetome okaka we Aesayakaho Omailimo ipalamidana lo mibo ga sa-loko luhuwa jibo ne:

content.text: Elilo, nemo gane lo-lele monitibo we oli hekoyoko emo le omutoko woko dukau yowanu litibomidana anuwaya wilebetakolaiye.
Mumusopa ebatokatiya aya welimo ga napauti sa-loko noliye: We napamu maya duka li wehe litalo. Dukau limitibo anula li wehe litalo.

content: Loko libo ga maya Jonito nisekaiyoko, mumusopa ebatoka woko nedanaki, Omailimo lihimanipo le hulobetatiye loko dukanipo li wili jikiki noku udatae loko lo beko ne.
Loko liyoko, Jelusalemu numutoka ito Judiya eba malokatiya wewena mukiya Joni nebotoka wiki lihimanipo li soto molikayoko, Jodani noku maya noku udobetaiye.
Joniya ya yupekaya lawolawolaya kamolo ja upaloti lolo abo nesa olo jekoko ja upaloti lolo abo ebelaya ohalalo jekoko pipiya nodenesa hituki lube nouvalakiya noko nebo ne.

Noko nedanaki, sa-loko lo beko nebo ne: Nemesaloka nonisibo weya elewoleyalalimo nemo elewoleyanemidana kohako ne. Nemoya aha we minoe. Emotoya kohamonako, emodaya elekele oetoko yowanu lasolamaki letatuboto kohamoe.
Nemoya aha noku udolibetobo neboya, emokahoya Omaimidana weuna oluholalotiya noku udolibetakolaiye, loko lo biye. 2 Mal 3:1 3 Aes 40:3 6 2 Kin 1:8
Jisesi maya noku udaiye.
Ya yupekaya Galeli mikaukaya eba mako neboya uliwa Naseleti. Jisesi maya Naseleti numutokati Joni neboto nisiyoko noku udotaiye.
Nokuti maya sinaiyoko, okulumama golotiyoko mudaboya Omaimidana weuna oluhoya nama luhukidana oko lemeko Jisesida elelaloma neyoko mudae.
Sa-iyoko, okulumauti maya ga mako sa-loko soto piye: Emoya nukane eme-minobo ipane maya minaninako, emodaya muda-elo lalo okoe. 11 Jen 22:2; Sam 2:7; Aes 42:1; Mat 12:18; Mak 9:7
Olohalimo Jisesida odalau hego mologo oko ne.
Sa-loko liyoko, weuna oluholimo Jisesida maya oli hekaiyoko mumusopa mikaloka wiye.

Yaloka maya woko onawa we lowesida di dadeloka suwoko le nohulaiyoko Olohalimoya niseko odalau hego mologo oko ne. Sa-iboya, Jisesi maya liwe aha-namasida luwanipouya neyoko, Omaimidana okanaki welalesiya nasahili itiki minae.
Galeli ebakuka maya Jisesimamo monoka yowanu le api iye.
Sa-iboya, Jonida maya nala numuku hulitikayoko neyoko, Jisesimamoya Galeli ebakuka woko Omaimidana gala lalo maya wetome oko sa-loko lo biye:
Aloya onawa okaiyo, Omailimo ujapa olibetatibo onawa maya alili okaiye, yamuya duka li wili jiki maya ga laloya eli elewole ilo, loko lo biye. 15 Mat 3:2
Jisesimamo lahawa likaka we loweki loweki ju liye.
Sakoya minoko yu makoya Galeli no apilaloka nomoniyoko, Saimoniko unala Endulukoya lahawa hikaka we minainako, lahawa owo maya huli nohuku ikiki minaiyoko, mudaidokoko sa-loko ju liye:
Hulikiki nemoki magoina wetune. Lahawa niheibo nesa liki wewenanelesitoya yowanu liki dilipi-liki nemotoka nisisaiye loko dilipe nomoloyo.
Loko liyoko, enemane iki lahawa owoma hulikaidanaki Jisesiki magoina wae.
Sa-ikaiyoko, Jisesimamo lasolasima nowidanaki, Jebetida ipala lowe Jemisiko unala Joniko maya asaiki noku lapeu maya miniki lahawa owo li wati wati niaiyoko mudaidokadanaki,
ju liyoko ahonipo Jebetile elekele oluholalesida maya aha noku lapeu minalo liki hulibitikiki Jisesiki maya magoina wae.
Oloha lahelamibo ukau nebo we.
Sakikiya Kapaniyamu numuto maya wayoko, monoka onawa maya alili okaiyoko, Jisesimamo monoka numuku maya yoweko monoka lo biye.

Monoka libo maya monoka monawa api-napi ibikaka abo wesi nesa leko lamiye. Aito wewenasida ganipolo emesalo molatae loko neyopa, eimola elewoleyalaki gala maya nenako, emesalo molatae loko lo bekaka ibo nenako, aiyo liki lae.
Sa-iyoko aya yupekaya olohamidana weuna oluho makolimo we makomidana madona le opa ibo we mako nebo ne.

Aya wemamoya alukada moloko Naseleti we Jisesiyo, emoya nenahalo lahelamibo nesa lolo oletakolo noane. Lilime opa etuwe loko nonisepe. Emodaya muda-elo wehe lo-minoe. Emoya Omailokati eto oko minadawo we maya minane.
Loko liyoko, Jisesimamo auha meko epaka mumukeikoko moletoko ukautiya lemeko wo.
Loko liyoko, ukala le opa noibo olohamamoya ilime momoga okoko opa napa ga nolidanaki ukalauti maya lemeko wiye.

Sa-iyoko, muki wewenasiya agae ni-liki maya nena nesa iye liki emo okepau mudao emo okepau mudao liki lae. Emoya monoka aitomidana abuha-wowolaki lobetokaka noiyoko, olohasidaya wilo liboto maya emesalo moliki wikaka niae.
Liki layoko, Jisesidamuya labo ga maya enemane oko Galeli ebakuka pou loko wiye. 22 Mat 7:28-29
Jisesi maya Pitada iloho dola ilime haka liye.
Sa-okaiyoko, hetoka limikikiya Jemisile Jonilemaki wiki akuya li Saimoniko Endulukosida numudanipou maya yowe.
Saimonida iloho dola maya upau jo libo nesa eloneyoko, Jisesida maya enemane iki li me.
Sakiya li meyoko, Jisesimamoya woko aya menamidana maya adelo leko ilime sinaiyoko, aya nesa maya suwoetokaiyoko sinokoko Jisesilemaki nasahili obetaiye.
Ho nolimiyoko Jisesimamoya muki wewenasida maya dilipe haka liye.
Sakoya ho maya lemekaiyoko, muki saina delaibo wewenahena ito olohamidana weuna oluho dukau nebo wewenahena maya dilipi-liki Jisesitoka maya nisi nisi aboya,
numuda ahola maya muki nisiki ateto maya li esa abo iliye.

Sa-ikayoko, aito aito nesa delaibo wewenahena ito olohamidana weuna oluho dukau nebo wewenahena maya dilipe lato-lato oko aya olohasida maya doli heko le hula hula iye. Sa-iboto maya muda-eli wehe layoko, sa-ibo nesa maya wetome amitae loko lo hukobetaiye.
Jisesimamo monoka lo beko monibo.
Okululuwa hokekolo sa-ibolawa maya, Jisesima sinoko hetoka lemekoko ametoka woko nedanaki Omailoka loko ne.
Sa-okaiyoko, Saimoni maya wewenalaleki ijaka hiki wadanaki,
wiki muda-elikiki muki wewena maya emokumuya ohu nije liki li me.
Liki layoko, muki ebaya wavu-leko alililoka ne loko lo biye. Sa-onenako, yatoka ebatoya woko monoka lo soto molatuwe loko wetune. Aya yowanu maya lituwe loko nonisoe.

Loko lokoko Galeli ebakuka moneko suwokadanaki, monoka numuda neboto neboto moneko monoka lo beikaka oko nedanaki, olohahena maya wewena dukautima oli heko le hula hula oko nebo ne. 39 Mat 4:23; Mat 9:35
Jisesida onoto mika ihi jelibo we haka liye.
Mika ihi jelibo we makolimo maya Jisesitoka niseko i bola heko sa-loko lo miye: Emoya nilime olutetuwe loko maya aha nilime olutonetamane.
Loko liyoko, Jisesi maya ukala hekaiyoko adela moloko upaloka leko sa-loko lo miye: Olutetane loko noloyo, oluto.
Loko liyoko aya mika ihi maya enemane oko olutoetokaiyoko,
Jisesimamoya aya we maya numudalaloka oli heko sa-loko lo miye:

Ele-minape. Olutadawo gaya wetome oko wewenakalesida olotiya lo bamo. Alo olutokane liki eli wehe litae loko woko Omailoka jokila he mekaka wema netiboto upaka maya ilipekadeko alo uliwitokane loko mudatiyo. Ito ulijedawomuya Mosesekaho libo nesa leko Omaitoka jokila hi mikadeko olutadawomidana monawa maya muki wewenasi eli wehe litayo.

Sa-loko lokaiyoko, aya wemamoya woko wetome-katome oko lo-lele moniye. Sa-okaiyoko, Jisesimamo taoniloka wetuboya wewena wavu-liki nisikilanako lokoko numuda lasolaukagoya neyoko, muki numutotiya maloka gala elebo wewenasiya nisi nisi ayoko, magoinaya minae. 44 Liv 14:1-32
